si_3_author_journal_and_year: Charles Laidi et al., Biological Psychiatry, 2022

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The main analysis used the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) cohort (multicenter, 6 sites). Dimensional analysis was conducted in the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) cohort (transdiagnostic pediatric cohort, 3 sites in NYC).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We analyzed data from the EU-AIMS LEAP (18). ... We conducted analyses in the Healthy Brain Network (34), an independent transdiagnostic mental health pediatric cohort recruited in New York, New York."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Laidi2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Participants; Dimensional Analyses in a Transdiagnostic Pediatric Cohort

answer.LEAP: normative training/testing (controls); patient for clinical research (individuals with autism)

answer.HBN: independent transdiagnostic cohort for dimensional analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: LEAP control subjects were used to train and cross-validate the normative model; LEAP individuals with autism and controls were then evaluated for individual deviations. HBN was used as an independent cohort for transdiagnostic dimensional analysis of autism-related symptoms.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A Gaussian process regression model was trained at each voxel in the control cohort ... We generated normative probability maps, which quantify the deviation of each participant from the normative model ... In this more heterogenous population of individuals with autism-related symptoms without a formal diagnosis of autism, we studied the influence of the clinical dimensions of autism..."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Laidi2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative Modeling; Dimensional Analyses in a Transdiagnostic Pediatric Cohort

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: The normative model was trained on the control cohort from the EU-AIMS LEAP study. While 10-fold cross-validation was used for internal evaluation of the controls (~197 per fold), the final model for predicting deviations in patients was retrained on the entire control sample (N=219).
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.supporting_text: "Control Subjects, n = 219 ... A Gaussian process regression model was trained at each voxel in the control cohort ... we used 10-fold cross-validation in neurotypical individuals before retraining the model in the entire sample to make predictions in individuals with autism."
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.location: Laidi2022.pdf.md: Table 1; 1-s2.0-S0006322322012781-mmc1.pdf.md: Supplementary Methods / Normative modeling analysis

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age information corresponds to the control cohort in Table 1, which was used for the normative model. The mean, SD, and range are explicitly stated. Median and IQR are not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The study reports a 64% male ratio for the 219 control subjects. 219 * 0.64 = 140.16, which is interpreted as 140 males and 79 females. 140/219 = 63.9%, 79/219 = 36.1%.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: "Control Subjects, n = 219 ... Sex Ratio (% of Males) 64%"
